title: Strategy detail shows the strategy at once and its real trading rules

problem_register_binding.operator_approval: 2026-11-25 conversation 52a1dacf (照建議 全部處理好)
problem_register_binding.hosted_read_only_diagnosis: 2026-11-25 06:35Z to 07:16Z on BFF adc027da9: StrategyDetail visible after 17.6 s / 12.2 s / 9.6 s while GET /bff/strategies/{id} answered in 1.7 s due to 12-read Promise.all and loading gate; rules summary filtered only role==='trading' so pool_member and pool_envelope rules of strategy-persona-a81b4fd15944698341aa rendered '尚未回報'.

details: useLiveDetail in StrategyDetail.tsx now awaits only bffV1.strategies.get(entityId) and gates initial full-page loading with `if (loading && !s)` so the page renders immediately after the single strategy read and keeps shown data during live refreshes instead of blanking.

Every secondary section (Watchers, Decision journal, Experiments, Risk & Alerts, Incidents, Artifacts, Evolution, Governance, Lineage, Audit, and Spec version history) tracks its own loading, ready, and unavailable state independently.
StrategyDetail.test.tsx verifies rendering with all secondary reads unresolved and one rejecting while the page remains usable, and verifies live refresh retains the displayed strategy.

StrategyDetail.spec.test.tsx pins 404 ('找不到策略'), 503 ('Strategy could not be loaded.'), network failure ('Strategy could not be loaded.'), and an unavailable strategy payload (meta.status === 'unavailable' -> 'Strategy could not be loaded.').

StrategySpecTab.tsx exports StrategyRulesList (reused by both StrategyDetail overview rules summary and StrategySpecTab) using deduplicateStrategyRules and resolveStrategyRuleRole from strategyRuleText.ts.

Recorded rules of strategy-persona-a81b4fd15944698341aa (rollback_baseline order_quantity 0, pool_member artifact-persona-paper-a81b4fd15944698341aa order_quantity 1, pool_envelope artifact-persona-pool-a81b4fd15944698341aa-v2) render the pool_envelope combination rule and risk limits, show the duplicated pool_member rule once, and label rollback_baseline as not traded ('不送單回滾基準' / 'No-order rollback baseline').

Null rules render unavailable ('無法讀取交易規則（執行套件讀取失敗）。' / 'Trading rules unavailable (execution bundle read failed).') and only an empty or omitted rules list renders not reported ('此策略尚未回報交易規則。' / 'This strategy has not reported any trading rules.').

When managementConsoleReads.lineage rejects or returns meta.status === 'unavailable', StrategyDetail renders strategy-lineage-unavailable ('Lineage unavailable' / '血緣資料暫時無法取得') and never 'No lineage available.'.

StrategyDetail.spec.test.tsx and StrategyDetail.lineage.test.tsx verify that every secondary section renders its section-specific unavailable state and never 'no data' or 'no matching records' when its read fails.

e2e/06-entity-registry.spec.ts adds a real Chromium browser timing test against a fixture BFF whose secondary reads delay 15 s and verifies StrategyDetail renders the header and recorded rules summary for strategy-persona-a81b4fd15944698341aa within 2 s (observed 1.3 s total test time).
No existing test was weakened or deleted, and no existing assertion was changed.

validation.result: 8 passed, 1 skipped (including real browser timing with 15 s secondary reads rendering StrategyDetail header and recorded pool rules in < 2 s)
